consequence.statement: An environment that installed cert-manager from OperatorHub keeps running v1.16.5, which still works, but no later cert-manager release will ever be published to that channel.
consequence.remediation: Obtain future cert-manager releases through another installation channel, since OperatorHub packages stop at v1.16.5.

assertion.statement: cert-manager maintainers no longer publish OperatorHub packages for cert-manager (both RedHat OpenShift OperatorHub and operatorhub.io), because they lack the time and resources to maintain and test them, and v1.16.5 is the last release available on OperatorHub.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: The evidence names no setting, values key, manifest field, image or resource that identifies environments whose cert-manager was installed via OperatorHub/OLM, so no evidence-grounded predicate can express the exposure.
